caseName: Newark Morning Ledger Co. v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Newark Morning Ledger Co. v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Solicitor General Biddle and Messrs. Robert B. Watts and Morris P. Glushien for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit denied.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this application. Mr. Charles Goldman for petitioner.
